fields.label: Commission Tiers
fields.description: Rate by the number of active referred customers when a payment is received. Leave empty for the published program: Seed 20%, Sprout 25% from 10 clients, Canopy 30% from 30.

fields.label: Minimum Payout
fields.description: A partner is paid only when approved, unpaid commission reaches this amount (before TDS). Smaller balances carry over.

fields.label: Payout Day of Month
fields.description: 1 to 28. Shown to partners as the next payout date.

fields.label: TDS Rate (%)
fields.description: Withheld from each payout (Sec. 194H). NEEDS BUSINESS/FINANCE CONFIRMATION.

fields.label: Hold Days
fields.description: Days after a customer's payment before its commission can be approved (a refund window). 0 = approvable at once.
